from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from factoryline.mission_control_status import mission_control_profile, mission_control_status
with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    root = Path(directory)
    first = mission_control_profile(root)
    second = mission_control_profile(root)
    assert len(first['spans']) == 5
    assert first['evidence_sha256'] == second['evidence_sha256']
    assert not any(first['authority'].values())
    assert mission_control_status(root)['agent_control_plane']['state'] == 'supervised_only'
print('ASSEMBLY_READ_PROOF_PASS')
